string.text: The map scale will change with character speed or camera height.
Hold the key to show or hide the map.
Enable the geometry overlay; runtime scene main map is the default. The terrain base and markers remain available.
Off retains the GDI terrain base and markers. The old bridge CPU cache diagnostic is available only with runtime main map off.
Runtime main map: cyan terrain and magenta objects for validation; off uses two neutral category colors. No material, walkability or floor semantics. Old bridge GPU retains its validation colors.
Log CPU update cost and mission tick intervals, not GPU execution time. Pause and state changes reset the window.
Turn off to render the retained original mesh. This does not change game collision.
Clip geometry above the selected world height to inspect lower structures. This is not a floor or pathfinding classification.

Clear, triangle and cached bridge use the old top-right diagnostic window. Main depth forward/reverse uses only the runtime GPU main map: gray ground, yellow upper plane, blue lower plane. Ignores ceiling without changing settings. Temporarily turn follow off to see all planes; occlusion must match both orders. No source geometry collection.
Old diagnostic window depth test (main depth probe always enabled)
Runtime scene preview. Left drag: orbit; right drag: pan; wheel: zoom; double click: reset. Closes on mission exit.

Extract the current scene at runtime
Read the loaded scene in small steps without offline geometry files. Disable only to inspect the old bridge cache. Bridge proxy and height clipping options do not apply to runtime sources.

Shared source setting for runtime main map and preview; each rebuilds independently. Collision reads copied shapes on the verified engine build. Sphere/capsule display approximations and unsupported shapes retain partial coverage reporting.

Old bridge cache: manual diagnostic only; no runtime scene coverage.

Shared by main map and preview. Copy loaded PhysX heightfields with holes and diagonals on the verified engine. Off: main map draws objects over GDI terrain; only the large preview uses height queries. No automatic disk or sampled fallback.
Shared by main map and preview, for raw runtime terrain only. Preserve borders and holes; accept patches within 0.10 m vertical error, otherwise retain original triangles.

Extract the current mission scene independently of the large preview. Off selects the old bridge cache diagnostic. Loading, failure or manual CPU retains the GDI terrain base and markers; no runtime building CPU rasterization or automatic bridge cache fallback.
